status: Mixed; each entry carries its own evidence class

entries.statement: The observed local region sits immediately downstream of an on-ramp merge and just upstream of an off-ramp diverge, and a dedicated auxiliary lane exists inside the region from the merge to the diverge.
entries.evidence: lane_geometry.json + lane_geometry per lane 6/7/8 support; official NGSIM metadata states five mainline lanes throughout plus one auxiliary lane between the Ventura Boulevard on-ramp and the Cahuenga Boulevard off-ramp.

entries.statement: Both approved windows are on the congested branch of the fundamental diagram, not the free-flow branch.
entries.evidence: local_state.json (10.51 m/s / 43.54 and 7.92 m/s / 50.51) with measured cross-section flows 1,647 and 1,451-1,474 veh/h/lane; official Table 3 SMS 21.45-27.70 mph and 20.88-23.22 mph.

entries.statement: The observed cross-section flow does not identify the traffic state: one flow value maps to two density/speed combinations.
entries.evidence: capacity_diagnosis.json (implied free-flow density at the same flow is about 16.5 veh/km/lane versus the observed 43.5-50.5) and the failed conditional runs that reproduced the same flow on the free-flow branch.

entries.statement: During 7:50-8:05 the whole study cross-section is congested and gets worse over time in every section, while the section first accumulates then drains vehicles.
entries.evidence: official Table 8 (space mean speed by section and 5-minute period: 45.44 fps then 41.88 fps then 30.03 fps) and Table 4 (net entering minus exiting +31, +24, +16, -38, -33 vehicles).

entries.statement: The on-ramp contributes a measurable inflow that the failed SUMO candidate did not contain at all.
entries.evidence: official Table 4 on-ramp sum 137 vehicles per 15 minutes (548 veh/h) for 0750 and 130 (520 veh/h) for 0805; trajectory lane-7 entries and official Table 6 flow step 8,064 -> 8,612 veh/h across the merge.

entries.statement: The upstream boundary demand of the real segment is directly observable; the true upstream demand of the freeway beyond the observed segment is not.
entries.evidence: the canonical states start at the segment boundary, so arrivals are observed only from that boundary inward; congestion upstream of the boundary is not observable.

entries.statement: The on-ramp arrival process is only partially observed because the ramp lane is observed over about 59 m immediately before the merge.
entries.evidence: lane_geometry on-ramp support (128.7-187.6 m) and ramp_flows.json first-observation caveat.

entries.statement: Which mechanism holds the region on the congested branch (initial condition / hysteresis, demand transient, or a downstream capacity restriction) cannot be identified from the observed windows alone.
entries.evidence: the windows are already congested at their start and the net in-out difference is small compared with the accumulation needed to build the queue, so the queue-forming event lies outside the observed time interval.

entries.statement: A SUMO scenario whose only capacity limit is the Krauss car-following model at the recorded parameters cannot be made to reproduce the observed congested state at the observed flow by adding the observed ramp or by matching the observed flow.
entries.evidence: capacity_diagnosis.json plus the failed conditional candidate that reproduced the internal cross-section flow on the free-flow branch.
